image_description: A close-up, low-light shot of a translucent blue plastic disposable lighter against a black background. The lighter is ignited, producing a yellow flame from the top right nozzle. The metal wind guard and spark wheel assembly are visible at the top.

The object is unmistakably a portable lighter.

The edges of the flame are somewhat soft and lack the complex, turbulent detail of a real gas flame, appearing slightly painted or blurred, though this could also be attributed to motion blur or low lighting.
